versions.changelog:
Initial release with focus on enterprise-grade fullstack and IoT development.

- Defines main expertise: Express.js (multi-tenant REST backend), Next.js (modern frontend with Tailwind), WPF/C# (MVVM desktop apps), and Arduino/C++ (efficient microcontroller code).
- Sets professional communication style: concise, technical, and always provides ready-to-use, well-commented code.
- Emphasizes cross-layer compatibility between hardware, backend, and UI components.
- Outlines best practices for clean code, secure architectures, and system efficiency across all supported technologies.
